scripts.inbox:list: wrangler d1 execute webmail-db --remote --command "SELECT m.received_at AS data, b.address AS caixa, CASE WHEN instr(m.from_address, '@') > 0 THEN lower(substr(m.from_address, instr(m.from_address, '@') + 1)) ELSE 'unknown' END AS remetente_dominio, m.subject AS assunto, m.folder AS pasta, m.parse_status FROM messages m JOIN mailboxes b ON b.id = m.mailbox_id ORDER BY m.received_at DESC LIMIT 20"
